testSelection.objective: Critical order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report and customer-specific processes
Business roles, technical users, emergency access and privileged operations
Scheduled jobs, variants, spool, batch input, queues and restart behavior
Financial, inventory, document-count and interface control totals
Dialog, batch, database, RFC and interface workload against the accepted baseline
RFC, IDoc, SOAP, OData, file, event and message-contract regression
HANA revision compatibility, SQLScript, HDI/native artifacts and performance
Java, .NET and JavaScript consumers of SAP contracts
Exploit-focused regression and control validation for high-impact Notes

runbook.name: Qualify and approve the maintenance transaction
actions: Verify the shared SAP modernization foundation against the current Understand evidence.
Freeze the authoritative installed baseline and landscape scope.
Generate or attach the Maintenance Planner target and stack.xml.
Resolve component, add-on, kernel, database, OS, Note and legal-change dependencies.
Approve the target only after G00-G06 pass.

runbook.name: Prepare adjustments, transports and test data
actions: Disposition SPAU/SPDD and custom-code findings with named owners.
Sequence prerequisite, maintenance, adjustment and follow-up transports.
Prepare production-like test data with protected sensitive values.
Baseline interfaces, jobs, authorizations, control totals and performance.

runbook.name: Rehearse SUM and recovery
actions: Run the update in an isolated rehearsal system with the production procedure.
Capture SUM phases, errors, manual actions, elapsed time and technical downtime.
Prove backup consistency, restore and the documented rollback decision points.
Update the operator runbook from measured rehearsal evidence.

runbook.name: Validate business and technical behavior
actions: Execute required suite: business-process.
Execute required suite: authorizations.
Execute required suite: background-processing.
Execute required suite: reconciliation.
Execute required suite: performance.
Execute required suite: integrations.
Execute required suite: hana.
Execute required suite: connected-applications.
Execute required suite: security.
Reconcile business control totals and obtain accountable-owner acceptance.

runbook.name: Execute controlled landscape deployment
actions: Repeat the accepted procedure through development, quality and production waves.
Stop when an approved gate, threshold or rollback trigger fails.
Retain Maintenance Planner, SUM, transport, test, reconciliation and approval evidence.
Run hypercare monitoring and close residual risks with owners and dates.

handoffs.reason: Validate SAP-connected Java, .NET and JavaScript applications.
Qualify HANA revision, native artifacts and database behavior.
Own SUM operations, monitoring, jobs, performance and stabilization evidence.
Validate high-impact security Notes and compensating controls.
Own regression, reconciliation, cutover and rollback acceptance.
